title: Permanent Release History & What's New System
releaseNotes: Taskly v1.6.0 introduces an integrated Permanent Release History and interactive What's New feature showcase in Profile → Version, allowing users to browse historical release notes across all 4 themes and compare versions with responsive compact-screen support.

history.title: Permanent Release History & What's New System
history.summary: Taskly v1.6.0 introduces an integrated Permanent Release History and interactive What's New feature showcase in Profile → Version, allowing users to browse historical release notes across all 4 themes and compare versions with responsive compact-screen support.
features: Permanent Release History in Profile → Version & Updates tracking all published Taskly versions
Interactive What's New modal showcasing categorized feature highlights and release notes
Historical version switcher with contextual diff comparison banners
One-time post-upgrade display automatically highlighting new features after an update
improvements: Fully responsive What's New layout optimized for compact Android displays down to 320px
Complete multi-theme support across all 4 themes (Light, Dark, Pet, Pastel)
Interactive collapsible history list with quick What's New inspection
fixes: Corrected legacy placeholder text for v1.5.0 historical release notes
security: Two-phase staged release-manifest publishing with atomic file replacement and automatic rollback protection
Pre-publishing schema validation and data loss prevention safeguards

history.summary: Taskly v1.5.0 brings approved Android notification branding with the Cat & Dog logo for system notices, monochrome paw status icon, cute cat mascot deadline alerts, and full in-app APK update capabilities.
Brand refresh, dynamic calendar priority intelligence & cute cat meow notifications
features: New Taskly Cat & Dog logo across Android launcher and web application
Dynamic calendar priority workload colors (Pink for High, Green for Medium, Cyan for Low, Grey for Homogeneous)
Custom category deletion with safe task reassignment to Personal
Cute Cat Meow notification sound on Android task reminders
improvements: High-contrast Dark Mode styling for Quick Capture cards and badges
Logout confirmation modal with duplicate-tap protection
Preserved Supabase authentication session across app updates
fixes: Fixed CSS declaration structure in public/styles.css
Separated Android monochrome notification icon from cute cat mascots

features: Supabase cloud database synchronization for tasks and notes
Secure user registration and email confirmation workflow
improvements: Offline-first local cache fallback when network is unavailable
fixes: Improved deadline reminder notification scheduling across device sleep cycles

features: Smart task management and progress tracking
Quick notes capture with pin functionality
Interactive calendar view and four theme system
